headline: Ukrainian radio maker Himera raises $5M in funding round
summary: Ukrainian military radio manufacturer Himera has raised $5 million in a funding round led by the Norwegian defense fund Gardar. The company plans to use the capital to scale production and expand internationally.
why: Defense technology startups have become increasingly important to Ukraine's industrial base during the war.

impacts.name: Himera
impacts.why: Capital injection allows for production scaling and market expansion.
